💡INTEL
========
📌Initially appeared in November 2025
📌A Ransomware Group which takes other major player's DLS site and edit it as their own and spreading it on Telegram Channel
📌Samples are distributed via Telegram Channel: Kazu Breach
📌No full leaks are present as of now
📌The DLS running at Apache/2.4.65 (Debian)
📌On 16 May, 2026; the group announced their come back
📌The US and Healthcare Industry is the top affected country and sector respectively
📌Earlier used Vanity Domain name, but recently got changed to non-Vanity TOR Domain
📌The group is reached via both Signal and Telegram
📌Currently 17 DBs are listed for Sale
📌Found the Real IP of the DLS hosted in Dark Web
📌The Hosting Entityt is notably infamous for hosting Credit Card Stealing Domains used in Magecart campaign using invisible SVG elements to inject a fake checkout overlay on 99 Magento stores, exfiltrating payment data to six attacker-controlled domains

REAL IP: 23.137.255.139 🇺🇸
